info.description: Task 5 contract-only Draft PR. No operations below are implemented or served by /api/docs.json. All 22 custom mechanics remain blocked from Hunt publication. See Participant_Gameplay_Contract.md for unresolved policies, invariants, existing endpoints and acceptance gates.
